verdict.rationale: Stripe documents creating, customizing (content and branding) and sending Stripe-hosted invoices, so the core invoice-generation part of the story is covered. Most of the specific compliance elements are not evidenced, and a community comment that Stripe lacks email invoicing, plus a note that customer emails are off by default, leave automatic delivery unclear. Missing for 10: credit notes, receipts, sequential numbering, custom fields and memos specifically, documented automatic delivery to customers, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: Create, customize, and send a Stripe-hosted invoice from the Dashboard, with no code required.
Customize invoices: Customize the content and branding of your invoices.
Create and manage subscriptions, track usage, and issue invoices.
